content.text:
Resubmitted and accepted.

**Fix applied:** the extra sentence "The Termination for Convenience Fee shall be Customer's sole payment obligation arising from such termination." was removed. Operation 2 is now a pure deletion of the add-on charges sentence, so the fee cap is achieved solely by (i) the new three-month average-monthly-Fees formula and (ii) deletion of the unamortized Conversion costs / disposition Expenses sentence — with no collateral effect on accrued Fees or Termination Assistance charges.

**Final fallback-complete redline (ok:true, minimality ok):**
1. § 11.1 — one year's notice → **ninety (90) days**; fee → **three months of average monthly Fees** for the three-month period prior to Customer's notice.
2. § 11.1 — delete the "In addition to the foregoing…" add-on costs sentence.
3. § 10.2 — "at any time" → **"effective only at the end of the Term"**, retaining M&I's existing 90 days' notice verbatim (element already met).

Untouched and still coherent: Estimated Remaining Value (p0039) for the Termination for Cause Fee, § 11.2(A), § 13.4 exclusion sentence, § 13.5 liquidated-damages acknowledgement, § 11.2(B) and § 20.3 offsets, and § 2.2 non-renewal (RENEWAL rule).
